test_title: PYST 26: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Morning)
subject: reasoning
question:
The sequence of folding a piece of paper and the manner in which the folded paper has been cut is shown in the following figures. How would this paper look when unfolded?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04ee1e702fa85bc2bf2671c9e1391040d6fdde0d44d256bb91694fdae596fc1b.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__****Both the vertical line is not exactly in the middle of the circle.** So cutting of outer part will not be cut 3 sides.

***Thus, here option figure 3 will be eliminated.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12c7fbc3545397a089de62c49db4182139bdcaa9c98c2473fb720eebb64cd2af.png] 

When we will unfold the paper for the first time, we will get the shapes on the upper half that are vertically unfolded.

Again, when we will unfold the paper for the second time we will get similar shapes on the right-hand side of the paper as the shapes are horizontally symmetrical.

Unfold the paper a third time we will get similar shapes on the left side of the paper as the shapes are horizontally symmetrical. The paper will look like the figure below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/585f250e30147ee92ad7dc5e8987270d6a8b6ae29fe3b02bc7333ff5980df8aa.png] 

Hence, the "first figure" is the answer figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**To get the unfolded figure,

**We have to imagine the dotted lines as a mirror and draw the mirror image about it.**
